items.title: After dodging death, battery startup Our Next Energy is now going public
items.summary: Our Next Energy is the latest battery startup to go public via SPAC. Does it now have what it needs to survive in a the cutthroat battery industry?
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Bedrock Energy raises $24M to build more AI-enabled geothermal drill rigs for enterprise buildings
items.summary: Geothermal heat pumps could free up significant space on the grid. Bedrock Energy raised $24 million to bring its AI-guided drill rigs to more markets.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
items.summary: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.
items.creator: Jagmeet Singh
